geometry.registration: cell centres; north_lat/west_lon are the first row/column centres

elevation.decode: metres = offset + scale * value; value == nodata means no data

dataset.name: Synthetic Gale-box demo terrain
limitations: SYNTHETIC: generated analytically for software testing. Not derived from any Mars observation; must not be used for scientific or operational interpretation.

Covers the MARGA Gale demonstration bounding box only so the UI can be exercised end to end before a real DEM package (e.g. Mars Trek Gale_DEM_SMG_1m export) is built. The surface is constrained to pass through the elevation_m of 8 catalogue targets (science_data/catalogue/gale_crater_targets.json, frontend/src/services/mockData.ts); all other relief is invented.
